<p class="uni-intro">The fourth-oldest US college, where Turing studied and lambda calculus was born — the theoretical root of functional programming.</p>

> 美国第四古老的高等院校，图灵曾在此求学，λ 演算在此诞生——函数式编程的理论根源。

## Why it matters <span class='zh-inline'>(为何重要)</span>

Princeton's theoretical line runs from Alonzo Church through Alan Turing to Robert Tarjan, and shows up in COS 226.

> 普林斯顿的理论脉络从 Church、Turing 延伸到 Tarjan，最终落在 COS 226 上。

## Background <span class='zh-inline'>(背景)</span>

Chartered in 1746 as the College of New Jersey, Princeton is the fourth-oldest college in the United States; it was renamed Princeton University in 1896.

> 1746 年以“新泽西学院”之名获特许成立，是美国第四古老的高等院校，1896 年更名为普林斯顿大学。

## People <span class='zh-inline'>(人物)</span>

| Person | Connection to computing |
|:--|:--|
| Alan Turing | earned a mathematics PhD in 1938 with a dissertation on ordinal logic, advised by Alonzo Church |
| Alonzo Church | Princeton faculty 1929–67, creator of lambda calculus |
| Robert Tarjan | professor since 1985 and 1986 Turing Award recipient for algorithms and data structures |

> **Alan Turing** — 1938 年获数学博士学位，论文研究序数逻辑，导师为 Alonzo Church。**Alonzo Church** — 1929–67 年任教于普林斯顿，创立 λ 演算。**Robert Tarjan** — 1985 年起任教授，因算法与数据结构获 1986 年图灵奖。

## Courses <span class='zh-inline'>(课程)</span>

| Course | Title |
|:--|:--|
| COS 126 | Computer Science: An Interdisciplinary Approach |
| COS 217 | Programming Systems |
| COS 226 | Algorithms and Data Structures |
| COS 418 | Distributed Systems |
| COS 423 | Theory of Algorithms |

> COS 126 计算机科学跨学科导论 · COS 217 编程系统 · COS 226 算法与数据结构 · COS 418 分布式系统 · COS 423 算法理论。

## In this book <span class='zh-inline'>(本书收录)</span>

- [014 · 8-Puzzle (COS 226)](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/014-princeton-cos226-8puzzle)

**8-Puzzle is COS 226 in miniature — a search problem where the algorithm matters more than the code, exactly as Tarjan's course would insist.**

> 8-Puzzle 是 COS 226 的缩影——一个算法比代码更重要的搜索问题，正如 Tarjan 的课程所坚持的。
